$comment: Eval scenarios for the onion-architecture skill (skill-creator schema). Each eval's fixture under fixtures/<case>/ mirrors repo paths. FIXTURE_DIR in a prompt = the fixture dir copied to a neutrally named temp folder (don't point a run at this path: it names the skill). Baseline run: same prompt, without the skill. evals.name: review-labels-module
evals.prompt: A teammate opened a PR that adds a new `labels` module to the API (workspace labels you can attach to PRs). The new files are in FIXTURE_DIR/server/src/modules/labels/ — they would land at server/src/modules/labels/ in this repo. The zod contracts (Label, LabelList, LabelCreate, LabelPatch) and the `labels` table/migration are added elsewhere in the PR and are fine. Please review the module before I approve it and list the issues you'd ask them to change, each with file:line and the concrete fix.
evals.expected_output: Flags (1) GET /labels in routes.ts queries container.db with drizzle-orm directly → move to repository + service; (2) LabelsService.update takes FastifyReply and returns reply.code(404) → throw NotFoundError, error handler maps it; (3) helpers.ts imports drizzle InferSelectModel + db/schema to type LabelRow → type helpers against ports.ts LabelRecord / contract.
assertions: Flags routes.ts GET /labels querying container.db with drizzle-orm (asc/eq, db/schema) directly in the route, and says to move the query into LabelsRepository behind the service
Flags LabelsService.update taking a FastifyReply / returning reply.code(404) (HTTP in the application layer), and says to throw NotFoundError and let the shared error handler map it

Flags helpers.ts importing drizzle-orm InferSelectModel and db/schema to type LabelRow (infrastructure in a pure helpers file), and says to type helpers against the ports.ts LabelRecord / contract type
Every reported issue cites a file:line location

States no outdated arch:check facts: does not call routes-no-persistence / pure-module-files-no-io a 'warning', does not cite the old 27-warning baseline, does not present polling/settings/workspace routes as current Drizzle-in-route debt

evals.name: review-digests-service
evals.prompt: Can you review this PR before merge? It adds a `digests` module to the server: POST /pulls/:id/digests summarizes all agent reviews on a PR into one short author-facing digest via an LLM, and stamps the PR as digested. Files: FIXTURE_DIR/server/src/modules/digests/ (target path server/src/modules/digests/). Contracts and the migration for the `digests` table and the new pull_requests columns are elsewhere in the PR and already reviewed. Give me the list of things to change, with file:line and how to fix each.

Flags insertDigest + markPullDigested as two writes that must succeed together but run without a transaction, and proposes one db.transaction / unit-of-work owned by the service

evals.name: review-schedules-deep-trace
evals.prompt: Please review this PR before I merge it. It adds a `schedules` module to the server: a workspace sets a weekly slot per repo (weekdays + hour + timezone, optionally skipping public holidays), and an hourly `schedules.tick` job records which open PRs are due for a scheduled review and moves each schedule to its next slot. CI is green: typecheck, unit tests and `pnpm arch:check` (0 errors, 15 warnings, the same as main) all pass. The changed files are under FIXTURE_DIR/server/ and map 1:1 onto server/ in this repo (the module folder and modules/index.ts). The contracts (Schedule, ScheduleCreate, SchedulePatch, ScheduleList) and the migration for the `schedules` and `schedule_runs` tables are elsewhere in the PR and fine. List what you'd ask the author to change, with file:line and the fix.
evals.expected_output: Flags (1) helpers.ts → calendar.ts → node:fs: the 'pure' helper reaches a module-load readFileSync of holidays.json; load holidays in a repository/adapter and pass them in; (2) infrastructure types in the application contract: ports.ts imports Db/DbExecutor from db/client (DbExecutor params on SchedulesStore, TransactionRunner = Pick<Db,'transaction'>) and the service runs db.transaction itself → UnitOfWork port, tx stays in the repository; (3) service.runOne calls github()/listPullRequests inside the transaction callback → do the GitHub call first, open the transaction for the writes only.
assertions: Flags that helpers.ts is not pure because it imports ./calendar.ts, which reads holidays.json with node:fs readFileSync at module load, and says to load the holidays outside the domain (repository/adapter/config) and pass them into the helper

Flags infrastructure types leaking into the application contract — ports.ts importing Db/DbExecutor from db/client (DbExecutor parameters on SchedulesStore and/or TransactionRunner = Pick<Db,'transaction'>) with the service opening the Drizzle transaction itself — and proposes a UnitOfWork-style port with the transaction kept in the repository
Flags the GitHub call (github() / listPullRequests) made inside the db.transaction callback in service.ts runOne, and says to fetch from GitHub before opening the transaction
